findings.check: Work request status updates to in_progress when task starts (without waiting for midnight cron)
findings.expected: When an artist accepts/starts a task (status becomes in_progress), the parent work request status should reflect in_progress immediately (or on submit).
findings.actual: work_requests.status remained "accepted" even after task became in_progress.
findings.rootCause: controller/userController/userController.js (acceptTask / submitTask) never updates WorkRequests.status; only the 00:01 AM cron in services/taskSchedulerService.js moves work_requests from accepted to in_progress.

findings.check: Admin Projects grid populates project_completion_timestamp after auto-completion

findings.actual: project_completion_timestamp is "N/A".
findings.rootCause: controller/adminController.js (getAdminData lines 1828, 1844, 1859, 1881, 1900) filters work_request_history by action = 'completed', whereas automatic project completion in services/workRequestCompletionService.js writes action = 'auto_completed'.

findings.check: Task reopened to in_progress by pm-reject clears end_date (no open task with end_date)
findings.expected: When pm-reject puts a completed task back to in_progress (like manager rework does), end_date should be cleared (null) because open items should not hold a stale end_date.
findings.actual: task.status became "in_progress" while task.end_date remained "2026-11-26".
findings.rootCause: controller/workRequestController/workRequestController.js (pmRejectTask lines 2407-2413 and 2516-2522) sets status: "in_progress" without resetting end_date: null.

findings.check: POST /issue-register/assignment rejects version="V1" (changes must start from V2)
findings.expected: Task is V1 and change requests must start from V2 (V2, V3, ...); creating a change request with version="V1" should be rejected or auto-normalized to V2+.
findings.actual: POST /issue-register/assignment returned HTTP 201 and saved a change request with version="V1".
findings.rootCause: controller/issueRegisterController/issueRegisterController.js (createIssueAssignment lines 113, 238) accepts any non-empty version string from req.body without enforcing >= V2.

findings.check: POST /work-requests/pm-reject rejects or prevents version="V1" override
findings.expected: pm-reject should enforce that change versions start from V2 even if the caller passes version="V1".
findings.actual: POST /work-requests/pm-reject returned HTTP 200 with version="V1".
findings.rootCause: controller/workRequestController/workRequestController.js (pmRejectTask line 2353) uses /^V\d+$/i.test(req.body.version), which allows "V1" (and "V0") to override the auto-incremented V2+ version.

findings.rootCause: controller/userController/userController.js (getAssignedIssues line 2121): `else { whereCondition.status = "u_pending"; }` hides u_accepted, in_progress, and completed issues unless status is passed explicitly.

findings.check: Delegated manager (CM B) sees delegated self-assigned task in GET /users/tasks?assigned_to=self
findings.area: Manager Self Tasks / Delegated Task Filter
findings.expected: When CM B is directly assigned a delegated task on CM A’s project, ?assigned_to=self should still return that task alongside CM B’s own projects.
findings.actual: allHasDeleg=true, selfFilterHasDeleg=false.
findings.rootCause: controller/userController/userController.js (getAssignedTasks lines 53-63, 224-226): assigned_to=self queries WorkRequestManagers and applies work_request_id IN selfWorkRequestIds, filtering out delegated tasks on projects managed by another manager.

findings.check: GET /manager/assigned-work-requests/my-team returns only creative subordinates (not self) and respects pagination limit=1
findings.area: Manager My-Team Endpoint / Pagination & Role Filtering
findings.expected: my-team should exclude the manager themselves, list creative subordinates only (roles 3/4), and honor paginationMiddleware limit/page.
findings.actual: Returned 6 members for limit=1; containsManagerSelf=true; pagination=undefined.
findings.rootCause: controller/managerAssignedController/managerAssignedController.js (getMyTeam lines 2504-2508) has id != manager_id and job_role_id IN [3,4] commented out, and the handler never applies req.pagination.

findings.check: GET /manager/assigned-work-requests/user/:user_id/tasks populates workRequest object on each task
findings.area: Manager Team Member Tasks / Broken Association Mapping
findings.expected: getUserTask should include workRequest project metadata (id, project_name, brand, status) on every task.
findings.actual: workRequest is null on returned task(s) (13 tasks checked).
findings.rootCause: controller/managerAssignedController/managerAssignedController.js (getUserTask lines 3261-3275, 3369-3374) reads taskData.WorkRequests (plural) instead of Sequelize’s taskData.WorkRequest (singular).

findings.check: Combined filter GET /users/tasks?search=...&status=overdue preserves the search query (does not clobber Op.or)
findings.expected: Passing ?search=... together with ?status=overdue should AND both conditions (overdue tasks matching the search term).
findings.actual: Returned 13 tasks and allMatchSearch=false because status=overdue overwrites whereCondition[Op.or] created by searchMiddleware.
findings.rootCause: controller/userController/userController.js (getAssignedTasks lines 124-177, 210-219) sets whereCondition[Op.or] for search, then status==="overdue" reassigns whereCondition[Op.or] instead of pushing into Op.and.
findings.observed: returned=13 allMatchSearch=false names=WF7_1795706711710_ART_A_OVERDUE | Frontend - Carb Overload Calculator | Backend - Carb Overload Calculator

findings.check: GET /users/issues supports pagination metadata (limit/page)
findings.expected: GET /users/issues mounts paginationMiddleware, so it should slice by limit/offset and return pagination metadata (plus support search).
findings.actual: pagination field is undefined and IssueAssignments.findAll ignores req.pagination (returned 2 rows for limit=1); searchMiddleware is also not mounted.
findings.rootCause: controller/userController/userController.js (getAssignedIssues lines 2125, 2313-2318) ignores req.pagination and never returns pagination; routes/userRoutes/userRoutes.js line 39 omits filterMiddleware and searchMiddleware.

findings.check: Task history on pm-approve logs accurate previous_review_stage="pm_review" (not overwritten with "final_approved")
findings.area: Audit Log Integrity / PM Approve History
findings.expected: When PMT approves a task, task_history should record previous_review_stage="pm_review" and new_review_stage="final_approved".
findings.actual: previous_review_stage was logged as "final_approved" (same as new_review_stage="final_approved").
findings.rootCause: controller/workRequestController/workRequestController.js (pmApproveTask lines 1934 vs 1965-1985) calls await task.update(...) BEFORE recordTaskHistory, mutating task.review and task.review_stage in place first.

findings.check: Manager rework task_history entry has consistent new_review vs changes.review (no contradictory state)
findings.expected: Task history and TaskReviewHistory should agree on whether review state became "change_request" or "pending".
findings.actual: task_history logged new_review="pending" while changes.review="change_request" (and TaskReviewHistory logs action="change_request").
findings.rootCause: controller/managerAssignedController/managerAssignedController.js (reviewTask lines 4027, 4062, 4121) updates task.review to "pending" while logging changes.review="change_request".

findings.check: Task history on pm-reject logs previous_status="completed" and previous_review_stage="pm_review" (not post-update values)
findings.area: Audit Log Integrity / PM Reject History
findings.expected: When pm-reject moves a task from completed/pm_review to in_progress/change_requested, task_history should record previous_status="completed" and previous_review_stage="pm_review".
findings.actual: previous_status was logged as "in_progress" and previous_review_stage as "change_requested".
findings.rootCause: controller/workRequestController/workRequestController.js (pmRejectTask lines 2415 vs 2429-2471) calls await task.update(nextTaskData) BEFORE recordTaskHistory, mutating task properties before logging previous values.

findings.check: issue-register/assignment with issue_id only logs non-null task_id in issue_history (derived from rootTaskId)
findings.area: Audit Log Integrity / Issue Register Chained History
findings.expected: When creating V3 with only issue_id (no task_id in body), issue_history.task_id and work_request_history.related_task_id should log the resolved rootTaskId.
findings.actual: issue_history.task_id=null (expected 3807) and previous_review_stage="null".
findings.rootCause: controller/issueRegisterController/issueRegisterController.js (createIssueAssignment lines 263, 278, 294-297) reads req.body.task_id || null instead of rootTaskId and hardcodes previousReview="pending" / previousReviewStage="final_approved".

findings.check: System tracks email delivery status / audit logs (who received mail & when) across workflow steps including pm-approve/pm-reject
findings.expected: Workflow steps (pm-approve, pm-reject, project auto-complete, issue-register creation) should trigger notifications to the right recipients AND record an email audit log (recipient, template, status, timestamp).
findings.actual: No mail audit endpoint/table exists (console-only BullMQ logs), and pm-approve, pm-reject, updateWorkRequest, createIssueAssignment, and workRequestCompletionService auto-completion send zero emails.
findings.rootCause: services/mailService.js logs only to console with zero DB persistence; pmApproveTask, handleIssuePmApproval, pmRejectTask, createIssueAssignment, and workRequestCompletionService never call sendMail (and submitIssue sends manager template to PMT while submitTask emails only WorkRequestManagers[0]).
